title: Meta partners with Reliance to lease its first AI data center in India, with 168 MW capacity; separately, Meta says it has contracted ~1GW of renewable energy (Meta Newsroom)
summary: Meta Newsroom: Meta partners with Reliance to lease its first AI data center in India, with 168 MW capacity; separately, Meta says it has contracted ~1GW of renewable energy — Takeaways — Meta has entered an agreement with Reliance Industries to lease our first AI-enabled data center in India to serve one of our fastest-growing communities.
